the search for new benchmark objects for the study of the properties of T dwarfs.
the discovery and characterization of the coolest brown dwarfs and exoplanets.

the discovery of new late T dwarfs in the solar neighbourhood and their characterisation using a combination of optical and infrared photometry, near infrared spectroscopy and evolutionary model fitting.

the WISE data release is an extremely valuable resource for finding wide binary T dwarfs and for studying the properties of late T dwarfs.

the current WISE data set is sufficient to find a few more T8 dwarfs at 50pc, but the majority of the late T dwarfs are at much larger distances and will be discovered in the future WISE data releases.

the current sample of metal poor late T dwarfs is biased towards young objects, and that the current sample does not represent the field population.
